criteria.intent: Complete linked issue/PR/commit/review/CI and exact merged acceptance; reconcile issue #13 against original criteria and genuine remaining gates.

The maintainer already authorizes this scoped optimization.

Normal protected merge and exact merged-source acceptance reconciliation are required. Local controlled fixtures do not satisfy these observations.

G03.description: Revalidate live owning issue to PR, exact Refs #35 commits, versioned independent review, reports and CI links. Update the actual issue-body AC checkboxes alongside the evidence table, checking only fully verified criteria and clearing invalidated evidence. Update #13 criterion-by-criterion against its original/current accepted intent and remaining first-release obligations; close only when the actual or explicitly superseded accepted scope is satisfied. No text-presence test supplies that human/live decision.
